pages.text: Look at any block of a vat with $(item)Engineer's Goggles$(). You see its pressure and heat bars, its contents, then the list of $(item)attachments$(): every machine the vat has counted.
When the vat sits idle, a red line tells you why:$(br2)$(li)$(item)An attached machine is not working: no recipe can run.$() Find the machine that is too slow or unpowered.

$(li)$(item)No recipe matches: check size, vat type and machines in JEI.$() The inputs are there but nothing fits: wrong vat kind, too small, or a machine missing.$(li)$(item)Not hot enough for this recipe.$() Add or light a firebox under the vat, or remove a freezer.

$(li)$(item)Pressure too low for this recipe.$() Add a compressor, speed it up past 120 RPM, or reverse it.$(br2)If a machine does not appear in the attachments at all, it is in the wrong place (outside the footprint, or a mixer off-centre on a 3x3), or it has no blade or electrode.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
